channel.title: MediaToday Co Ltd - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from MediaToday Co Ltd (maltatoday.com.mt)

item.title: Constitutional Court rules against Ferris in unjust dismissal case
item.description: Constitutional Court quashes lower court decision ordering former police inspector and FIAU manager Jonathan Ferris be awarded €20,000 in damages over unjust dismissal from police corps

item.title: Schools in Mellieħa, St Paul’s Bay and Qawra will not open on Tuesday, MCAST lectures shift online
item.description: Education Ministry announces closure of Mellieħa, St Paul’s Bay and Qawra primary schools on Tuesday following red weather warning • Ministry says students from other schools who stay home on Tuesday due to weather-related concerns will be considered excused for the day

item.title: Three schools to close as storm disrupts Gozo ferry, authorities urge public to stay indoors
item.description: Schools in Mellieħa, Qawra and St Paul’s Bay will not open on Tuesday due to staff shortages caused by ferry disruptions, as Home Affairs Minister Byron Camilleri appeals for caution amid red weather warning conditions

item.title: Alex Borg wants consumer and energy agencies to probe ARMS billing ‘fiasco’
item.description: Opposition leader Alex Borg says thousands of families were negatively impacted by an error in the utility billing system, accuses ARMS and energy minister of misleading public

item.title: Energy ministry orders independent audit of ARMS billing system after eco-reduction controversy
item.description: Minister Miriam Dalli has asked for an independent audit of ARMS’s accounting system despite the company saying earlier billing problems were resolved

item.title: BCA, OHSA urge halt to outdoor construction work, enforcement and inspections to continue during storm
item.description: Authorities are calling for construction sites to suspend outdoor activity and secure materials as severe winds hit Malta, while enforcement and workplace safety inspections will continue despite the extreme weather

item.title: Legendary Italian fashion designer Valentino Garavani dies aged 93
item.description: The couturier famed for “Valentino red” and for dressing generations of royalty and Hollywood stars passed away in Rome, leaving behind a global fashion empire and a legacy of timeless glamour

item.title: Emergency contraception still not available for free
item.description: Providing the morning-after pill for free was a key proposal in the National Sexual Health Strategy but more than a year later it remains unavailable

item.title: Yes, prices have gone up, but buying your own home has always involved sacrifice
item.description: If couples in the past lived a simpler life and had to make sacrifices in order to finally be able to afford “il-post” then in reality that has not changed

item.title: Last year recorded lowest rate of reported theft since 1998
item.description: Malta recorded its lowest rate of reported theft last year, according to figures tabled in parliament last week
